chunks: Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah and ʿAbd Allah ibn Jaʿfar, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from his brother ʿAli ibn Mahziyar, from al-Hasan ibn Saʿid, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Basir, from Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
Al-Hasan ibn ʿAli عليه السلام passed away when he was forty-seven years old, in the year fifty. He lived for forty years after the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.

key_terms.الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ: Imam al-Hasan ibn ʿAli عليه السلام
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; was taken in death

ai.seo_question: When did Imam al-Hasan ibn ʿAli عليه السلام pass away, and how old was he?
ai.summary: This report gives a brief biographical notice about Imam al-Hasan ibn ʿAli عليه السلام, stating his age at death and the year in which he passed away. It also notes how many years he lived after the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, preserving a historical detail about the Imam’s life.

en.hubeali:
Sa’d Bin Abdullah and Abdullah Bin Ja’far, from Ibrahim Bin Mahziyar, from his brother Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Al Hassan Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> passed away and he<sup>asws</sup> was forty-seven years old, in the year fifty. He<sup>asws</sup> lived after Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> for forty years’.
en.sarwar: 2. Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah and ‘Abdallah ibn Ja‘far have narrated from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother. Ali (ibn Mahziyar) from al-Hassan ibn Sa‘id from Muhammad ibn Sinan from ibn Muskan from abu basir from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Al-Hassan ibn Ali (a.s.) passed away at the age of forty seven up to the year fifty (AH). He lived forty years after the death of the Holy Prophet (s.a).”
